findings.explanation: dataSources calls this field enumerated, and an enumeration does not increment. The SPL only tests the text of the value with a regex.
findings.quote: or when `upsLastTransferReason` increments on the trap path
findings.suggested_fix: Describe it as an enumerated cause code that is matched, or count changes in it explicitly in the SPL.

findings.explanation: Check PowerNet-MIB: the APC object for the cause of the last transfer to battery is believed to be `upsAdvInputLineFailCause`, so `upsLastTransferReason` may not exist. `upsBasicOutputStatus` is an enumerated state, not status bits, and the SPL never reads it.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm the real OID names and value enumerations in PowerNet-MIB, and drop `upsBasicOutputStatus` from the primary readings unless the SPL uses it.

findings.explanation: The SPL hard-codes 108 and 132 V and has no lookup. The text also says the alert fires only when voltage stays below 108 V across two polls, but the SPL fires on a single reading in a 15-minute bucket.
findings.quote: Normalize nominal voltage using lookup `ups_nominal_voltage` keyed on `host`.
findings.suggested_fix: Either add the nominal-voltage lookup and the two-poll condition to the SPL, or reduce the text to the fixed 108/132 V thresholds the SPL applies.

findings.explanation: Check whether Splunk Connect for SNMP emits `snmp:apc:ups` and `snmp:trap`, and whether it can be installed on a Heavy Forwarder as the prerequisites imply. SC4SNMP is normally deployed on Docker or Kubernetes and sends via HEC.
findings.suggested_fix: State the sourcetypes SC4SNMP really writes and its supported deployment model.

findings.explanation: The UC has no CIM model (`cimModels` is empty), so this validation step does not apply. Steps 3 and 4 are also missing from the numbering.
findings.quote: Confirm CIM field extractions resolve by running `| datamodel <model> search | head 1`
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with a check against the APC web UI input voltage and the event log, and renumber the steps.

findings.explanation: The UC polls APC PowerNet-MIB objects, not RFC 1628 objects, and the APC link titled as an application note is the same FAQ cited elsewhere. Neither reference supports the OIDs used.
findings.quote: IETF RFC 1628 — UPS Management Information Base
findings.suggested_fix: Cite PowerNet-MIB for `upsAdvInputLineVoltage` and the transfer-cause object, and verify that the APC FAQ page covers them.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: The title promises voltage sag with transfer to battery, but the `where` clause is an OR across under-voltage, over-voltage (`vin > 132`) and any transfer-reason match. An over-voltage reading alone raises an alert.

`match(toString(reason), "(?i)transfer|battery|boost|trim")` would also match a no-transfer value such as `noTransfer`, producing a row on healthy polls. Check the enumeration labels and anchor the regex.

summary: A reasonably specific APC UC, but the SPL is broader than the title and the implementation describes logic the SPL does not have. Several PowerNet-MIB object names and semantics are doubtful.
